title: Post-pin benchmarking and safety harness runner for model version changes
creator: Sofia Alvarez
description: Purpose: Ensure every model version pin or upgrade (both catalog and customer-locked versions) triggers a lightweight but rigorous post-pin benchmarking and safety harness run that validates key quality signals before traffic is fully routed. This ticket scopes the orchestration layer, acceptance criteria, and Console UX notifications for the runner.
acceptance_criteria: 1) New or changed model pins (catalog or customer-specific) automatically start a post-pin job within 5 minutes of the pin event. 2) Job executes a configurable suite: smoke generation set, safety classifiers, embedding drift check, and latency/cost profiling. 3) Outcomes recorded to the eval-store and surfaced in Console with pass/fail, diff summaries, and top failing prompts. 4) If thresholds are breached (semantic degradation > X, safety fail rate > Y, latency regression > Z), job triggers an automated canary hold and optional rollback path. 5) Owners and affected customers receive clear notifications and links to remediation playbooks.
implementation_notes: - Trigger: wire into the pin-change webhook used by catalog and customer-pin flows; ensure idempotency and dedupe for rapid successive pins. - Runner: a lightweight orchestration job that replays representative prompt slices (sampled per-use-case) and runs safety heuristics and embeddings drift. Use existing probe-runner infra where possible to save cycles. - Config: default job template for hosted catalog pins; allow customer overrides for pinned models (customer-managed sample sets and thresholds). - Metrics: emit token-level cost, median latency P50/P95, semantic-similarity delta (embedding cosine), safety-flag rate, and top-10 failed prompts. - Storage: write results to eval-store table with model_version, pin_source, job_id, metrics_summary, raw_diffs link. - Console: add a Post-pin tab on model pin pages showing recent runs and an action to re-run or escalate. - Rollout: staged: beta on internal catalog models -> opt-in for select customers -> default for all pinned changes. - Fallback: if job infra is unhealthy, default to conservative canary (no traffic >0) and alert SRE.
telemetry_and_monitoring: Collect: eval_run_duration_seconds, eval_token_cost_usd, eval_semantic_delta, eval_safety_fail_rate, eval_latency_p95_ms. Dashboards: add per-model and aggregated dashboards; create alert if >5% of pins yield semantic_delta > 0.08 across production models. Record correlation with downstream customer error rate and post-rollback incidents.
ui_and_notifications: Console: Post-pin result card with PASS/FAIL, short human-readable summary, link to full diff and failing prompt examples. Notifications: in-product toast for owners, email to customer contacts if their pinned model fails strong safety checks, and Slack ops channel alerts for P0 regressions. Provide a Re-run button and a Retrospective link to a Confluence playbook.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: noisy false positives from sampling; Mitigation: progressive thresholds, allow customer sample overrides and amplify representative samples from production traces. Risk: cost increase from frequent evals; Mitigation: lightweight defaults, rate-limits, and sampling heuristics with a cost budget per customer. Risk: delayed pin propagation if job stalls; Mitigation: conservative canary and health checks with escalation.
out_of_scope: Full-scale preflight for every minor configuration change (this ticket only covers model version pins/explicit upgrades). Deep offline model quality training diagnostics are tracked separately.
